title: Independent audit: selected PR1094 pending-axis independence and all source-touch cuts
head: d1ba263139ceb6eb811628b7560a3f87f3c9652e
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Distinct pending-axis labels do not alone establish independent F2 subspaces, even when each child's axes are locally orthonormal. This adds a data-only independent audit of that inherited premise and every chronological reservation boundary in the selected PR1094/T16 construction. The selected input passes; no discrepancy or new κ is claimed.

The verifier checks 896 complete pending bases (1,335,936 exact Gram entries plus independent row reduction), all 69,120 whole-helper roles, and a forward sweep of 480 replica-local pre-bank events / 481 cuts. It reads no `PLAN.windows` and imports no supplier or owner checker. The complete idle suffix and frozen local-plus-idle profile agree. The receipt includes every cut count, exact source hashes and the verifier hash.

A source-sized control preserves distinct axis labels, child ranks and local orthonormality while making two pending child spans overlap. The README supplies the standard Gram argument and the minimal `[7]` versus `[1,2,4]` counterexample. This tests a weaker inference; it does not allege a defect in the selected certificate, whose production lineage inherits orthogonal-chart checks.

No scalar/native/phase replay, dirty-state restoration proof, spectator-chart validation, precision/tape/invoice pricing, all-size compiler or multiplication theorem is claimed. The selected frontier and frozen inputs are unchanged. Only `research/selected1094-pending-axis-audit/` is added.

## Task and overlap

Task: `supplier-boundary-audit`, selector nonce `ffadb302921634922991e5d18e3cc4f6`; scoped card in `TASK.json`. Main base `1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`. Selected PR1094 source `0fc329d0bec93ca7cd288eaea1295172e8789810`, on PR1087 `589d1cedf5ef5f231182f4ec86408616311a8af0`.

Deliberate independent audit of Josie Elliston's PR1091 X2 premise and strict-window boundary, already applied by the maintainer to PR1094. The added evidence is explicit cross-child Gram/rank verification and the full forward reservation-cut census. PR1149 concerns local canonical-frame recursive ranks on PR1042; PR1183 concerns a changed T37 mixed-provider owner map. Live PR bodies and Discussions were checked at entry and refreshed before submission. No exclusive reservation is claimed.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -B research/selected1094-pending-axis-audit/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/selected1094-pending-axis-audit/test_audit.py
python3 -I -O -B research/selected1094-pending-axis-audit/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/selected1094-pending-axis-audit/test_audit.py
python3 -B scripts/verify_selected_result.py
```

All five commands pass on macOS/arm64, CPython 3.14.7. The 16 tests include one full positive fixture and 15 controls for algebraic dependence, cross-child Gram failure, premature touches/deadlines, coordinate collisions, prefix holes, source pins and role/profile integrity. Normal and optimized verification both match the deterministic committed receipt. Exact commands, output, environment and package hashes are in `VALIDATION.json`. Staged whitespace checks pass. Full supplier cold replay and hosted CI are not run for this scoped data-only audit.
